name: balenaEtcher
description: balenaEtcher periodically checks electron-updater when updates are enabled, compares the returned version and staging percentage, and retrieves a selected newer release; install-on-quit and signature enforcement remain unverified from the reviewed application source.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; released artifact behavior may differ.

The inspected application code delegates package authenticity/signature enforcement to Electron/Electron Updater or the platform installer; no independent publisher-key verification is shown in this snapshot.
